headline: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
summary: Slack introduces "Slackforce Surfaces" to create interactive reports and dashboards. Users can build polls, presentations, and other tools directly within chats. AI-powered Slackbot gathers information from conversations and connected apps.

headline: Schools are catching on to Big Tech’s playbook
summary: AI companies are aggressively promoting their tools in schools, mirroring past tech industry tactics. They argue that AI skills are vital for students' future job prospects. Companies often provide free educational resources and curricula to schools.

headline: Amazon’s Fire TV Stick 4K is over half off at under $20
summary: The Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K is on sale for $16.09 with a special coupon code. This deal is available through Woot until September 13th. The device features Wi-Fi 6 support and 2GB of memory.

headline: Electric air taxis get the green light for test flights in Texas
summary: A new federal program starts test flights for electric and autonomous aircraft in Texas. The FAA selected Texas for its Advanced Air Mobility and eVTOL Integration Pilot Program. Testing begins even before final regulatory rules for the technology are set.

headline: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset With Infinite Battery Life Drops to $250
summary: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset is now available for $250. It boasts an "infinite battery life" feature for continuous gaming sessions. This deal represents a significant price drop for the high-end headset.

headline: The Retroid Pocket Duo Looks Perfect for DS and 3DS Emulation
summary: The new Retroid Pocket Duo is an Android-powered handheld designed for emulation. It features a dual-screen setup ideal for Nintendo DS and 3DS games. The device caters to the ongoing renaissance in handheld gaming, focusing on retro titles.

headline: Hasbro Responds to DHS Using AI Optimus Prime in Deportation Posts
summary: Hasbro has issued a response regarding the DHS's use of an AI Optimus Prime image. The Department of Homeland Security reportedly used the image in deportation-related social media posts. The details of Hasbro's statement clarify their position on the unauthorized usage.

headline: The 34" AOC Agon Pro QD-OLED Gaming Monitor With Massive 4 Year Warranty Drops to $399.99
summary: The 34-inch AOC Agon Pro QD-OLED gaming monitor is now priced at $399.99. It is among the most affordable ultra-wide OLED gaming monitors on the market. The monitor comes with an impressive 4-year warranty, a standout feature in its category.

headline: MPs to vote on legalising assisted dying in England and Wales
summary: Members of Parliament in England and Wales are set to vote on legalizing assisted dying. A similar proposal previously gained majority MP support but stalled with peers. This vote marks a significant step for the contentious legislative issue.

headline: Spies, strategies and missed opportunities: How the lessons of 9/11 are still being learnt
summary: Twenty-five years later, the 9/11 attacks continue to shape global foreign and security policies. The BBC's security correspondent analyzes the enduring impact and lessons learned. The event has profoundly defined a generation of intelligence and strategic planning.

headline: Oil, gas and borrowing costs surge as fears over Middle East escalate
summary: Oil prices have surged to $105 a barrel amid rising tensions in the Middle East. Fears are growing that the conflict in Iran will not be swiftly resolved. The escalation is also causing increases in gas prices and global borrowing costs.

headline: Anthropic blocks 'malicious use' of AI that could develop biological weapons
summary: Anthropic has intervened to prevent its AI from being used for malicious purposes. The company acted over concerns that AI could be used to develop biological weapons. This follows warnings from a former top researcher about AI's potential risks to humanity.
